title: Růžice (Rosettes)
description: Prepared with egg white, cream, and eggs.
steps: Reserve one egg white in a bowl for later use
Mix together the remaining eggs, sugar, sweet cream, and salt
If available, add wine; if not, it can be omitted but the result will be less flavorful
Mix well and add enough flour to make the dough slightly thinner than noodle dough
Roll out very thin, like noodle dough
Use five different cutters of graduated sizes, each noticeably smaller than the next, to cut out circles
Place on a cloth dusted with flour
Beat the reserved egg white until stiff peaks form

Brush the center of the largest circle with beaten egg white and stack the remaining four circles on top, largest to smallest, pressing gently in the center with a finger moistened in egg white to create a dimple and help the petals hold together
Be careful not to apply egg white to a large area, or the petals will not separate properly
Heat lard in a pan and fry the rosettes carefully until they are red but not burnt
Beat one egg white into stiff peaks
Place a piece of stiff beaten egg white in the center of each rosette, top with a few grains of red sugar, or fill with jam instead
The petals should rise beautifully during frying to resemble an actual rose

title: Salmy z koroptví (Partridge Salmi)
description: Prepared with partridges, onion, and lard.
steps: Pluck the partridges and carefully remove the skin, keeping only the wing tips and lower part of the legs with skin.
Chop the meat and pound it in a mortar, do the same with the bones.
Add to the mortar four tablespoons of chopped meat, one raw egg and two eggs soaked in squeezed milk, a little flour, ginger, pepper, a quarter chopped onion and a piece of lard.
When pounded, push the mixture through a fine sieve.
Add chopped lard cubes to the pressed mixture and mix everything together.
Stuff the skin with the mixture and sew it closed.
Boil for half an hour.
Slowly press until all juice flows out.
Let cool, then cut into thin slices.

Remove the fried potatoes with a skimmer and place in a dish; when all are fried, if they are not salty enough, salt them

title: Skopové hrudí s dušenou rýží (Mutton Brisket with Rice)
description: Prepared with mutton, rice, and beef broth.
steps: Clean a nice mutton brisket well, cut off a small lower bone, let it boil for a quarter hour in salt water, then cool.
Now trim the brisket neatly and let it cook slowly in beef broth until tender.

Meanwhile, pick over a large cup of nice rice, place it on a shallow pan, pour two cups of broth from the brisket and two cups of water over it, add an onion into which you have pressed two cloves, a piece of butter, salt it.
Cover the pan and let the rice braise slowly until it is tender and all the liquid is absorbed into it.
Now place the rice on an oblong platter, lay the brisket cut into neat pieces on it, and pour a little of the broth in which you cooked the brisket over it.

steps: Mix the warm milk with compressed yeast and add fine flour until the dough is about the consistency of dumpling dough; let it rise. If compressed yeast is not available and dried yeast is used instead, prepare the dough in the evening and let it rise overnight.

Grease a pan of ordinary size (about 8 by 14 inches), place the dough in it, and when the pan is three-quarters full, bake over moderate heat.

Sprinkle well with finely chopped almonds or peanuts mixed with grated bread and sugar.
Place again on a pan and let dry in a not too hot oven until brown.

When roasted, slice into cutlets and serve

title: Tažená Štrudle s Jablky (Apple Roll)
description: A bread preparation made with apples, bread, and raisins.

ingredients.name: a piece of butter about half an egg in size
ingredients.sourceText: a piece of butter about half an egg in size

steps: Pour one cup of clear warm water into a cup and dissolve in it a piece of butter about half an egg in size
Add one whole egg, about one quarter cup sugar, and a pinch of salt
Put about one quart of flour on a pastry board, make a large well in it, pour the water mixture into it, and work into a stiff dough like for buns
Knead well, beat with a rolling pin, cover with a bowl and let rest for one hour
Meanwhile, peel good apples and cut into thin slices
Fry grated bread in butter and pick through and clean one half pound of raisins
Spread a cloth, dust lightly with flour, and stretch the dough very thin on it
Lay apples in a line next to the cloth edge, sprinkle with the fried bread and raisins, then with sugar, dust with ground cinnamon and sprinkle with melted butter
Gradually lift one side of the cloth, rolling the strudel into a roll
Grease a baking pan well with butter, roll the strudel into it in a circle, brush the surface with butter and let it bake slowly for one hour
While baking, brush with butter; when half-baked, pour over a cup of milk and finish baking
When done, turn out onto a long platter (platter), cut into slices and sprinkle generously with powdered sugar

Cook one cup of nice cleaned rice in one quart of milk until soft and let it cool
